newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, erasing early gain.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, erasing early gain.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Tuesday after distant months erased earlier price gains on sell orders from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen lower to 1.0 yen higher, with benchmark December contract down 0.9 yen at 117.0 yen per kg.
Most months gained from the opening, but technical selling from local investors capped the topside by late afternoon, traders said.
Traders are watching to see if the International Natural Rubber Organisation (INRO) intervenes in the market.
